test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A thief is spotted by a policeman from a distance of 100 m. When the policeman starts the chase, the thief also starts running. If the speed of the thief is 8 km/h and that of the policeman is 10 km/h, how far will the thief have run before he is overtaken?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between thief and policeman = 100 m

Speed of the thief = 8 km/h

Speed of the policeman = 10 km/h

**Concept:**

The distance covered before the thief is caught is (Relative Speed × Time).
